heading: Available for clubs, festivals and radio shows across Europe.
heading_cs: K dispozici pro kluby, festivaly i rádia po celé Evropě.
description: Techno and house sets, radio show guest mixes and remixes. Based in Zlín, Czech Republic — playing across the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Germany and Luxembourg.
description_cs: Techno a house sety, hostovské mixy do rádií a remixy. Sídlí ve Zlíně a hraje po celé České republice, na Slovensku, v Polsku, Německu a Lucembursku.
